name: BEST SPAC I Acquisition Corp. Unit
summary: BEST SPAC I Acquisition Corp. currently has no substantial business activities. Its main objective is to complete a strategic business combination, which could involve a merger, an exchange of shares, an acquisition of assets, a stock purchase, a corporate reorganization, or a similar transaction, with one or more existing enterprises. The corporation was established in 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
